annotation.title_clean: 無人航空機の飛行に関する許可・承認の審査要領(カテゴリーⅡ飛行)
annotation.title_en: Review Guidelines for Permission/Approval of Unmanned Aircraft Flights (Category II Flights)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 航空局長 (Director General, Civil Aviation Bureau, MLIT)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Civil Aviation Bureau review guidelines for permission and approval of Category II unmanned aircraft flights under the Civil Aviation Act. They set application procedures, aircraft performance, pilot competence, safety-system standards, and additional criteria for night, beyond-visual-line-of-sight, over-event, hazardous-goods and payload-drop flights.
key_provisions_or_claims: Flights in prohibited airspace or outside prescribed methods require MLIT permission/approval, applied for 10 working days ahead.
Aircraft must meet performance standards; 25kg+ aircraft need fail-safes, flight data recording and third-party liability insurance.
Pilots without a skill certificate need 10+ hours of flight experience, legal and safety knowledge.
Additional criteria for night, BVLOS, crowded areas, events, hazardous goods and payload drops, including exclusion zones.
Accident reporting and flight plan notification via the drone information platform are required.
